fields.description: Which provider new conversations use by default.
fields.label: Default Provider

fields.description: Which model new conversations use by default.
fields.label: Default Model

fields.description: The core's own instructions, assembled before any extension's agent persona. An extension contributes content to this prompt, never the assembly logic.
fields.label: Core System Prompt

fields.description: The most provider round-trips one turn may make. Mirrors MAX_PROVIDER_CALLS — a turn that needs more is a turn that should have been a flow.
fields.label: Max Provider Calls

fields.description: The most tool calls one provider response may ask for. Mirrors MAX_TOOL_CALLS_PER_RESPONSE.
fields.label: Max Tool Calls Per Response

fields.description: How long chat logs are kept. They are an audit trail, not a business record, so they are pruned by age.
fields.label: Retention (days)

fields.description: A JSON list of the extensions this site has activated. Activation is not installation: an app must be installed with bench install-app first, and this list only decides which installed extensions are live.
fields.label: Enabled Extensions

fields.description: Tool names to hide from everyone, one per line or comma-separated. This list only ever narrows the surface — it cannot make a tool available that the permission matrix already refuses.
fields.label: Disabled Tools
